_about: Project settings for master-harness. merge: auto (merge when CI is green), safe-only (merge only PRs that touch safe_paths; everything else waits for the owner) or owner (the owner merges every PR). merge_deploys: true if merging to the default branch puts the code live (Vercel/Netlify auto-deploy, a deploy workflow on push). When it is true, a PR also waits for the owner while human steps are queued or eyes-on checks are open. A file is safe if it matches safe_paths and not never_auto_paths; an exact path (no wildcard) in safe_paths is always safe. max_phases_per_launch: 0 = no limit.
